jobs.caseLog:
GREEN DYNASTY vs. DONNA RAINS — FULL CASE LOG (as of Aug 14, 2026)

PARTIES
Contractor: Green Dynasty Construction LLC — Bobby Green; project rep Benny Mancillas (40% stake in recovery).
Homeowner: Donna Rains, 105 Glynn Way Dr, Houston TX 77056. CEO of ~$70M Port of Houston freight company. $2M+ home. Litigation-experienced.
Attorney: Mr. Knutzen ("DJ") for Green Dynasty.

CONTRACT — signed Oct 11, 2025. Residential Construction Service Agreement, mold remediation + full rebuild across two USAA claims. 1.5%/mo interest ($46.47/day); homeowner pays contractor's attorney fees on breach (Sec 8.0); owner responsible for full price regardless of insurance timing (Sec 5.0); no mediation clause.

MONEY
Claim 1 build-back $89,305.05 — paid in full.
Claim 2 mitigation $9,789.46 — paid in full.
Claim 2 build-back $153,159.04 — $60,000 paid.
Pantry door credit ($209.43).
BALANCE DUE: $92,949.61.
Billed at USAA-approved Xactimate pricing; all subs paid in full out of pocket before she paid on Claim 2.

TIMELINE
Oct 11 2025 contract signed. Nov–Dec: she moved into the active site before completion, disrupted scope, blamed the timeline on GD. Dec 25: Bobby, Benny + sub fixed a prior plumber's leak on Christmas Day, no charge. Jan–Feb 2026: HVAC; documented mini-split delays tied to a separate leak claim. Apr 10 & 13: GD tried to schedule punch-list; dismissed/ignored. Apr 14: her first written attack (gym floor "worst installation", insults, blamed Bobby for Elevation mediation). Apr 21: Benny completed remaining Claim 2 punch items; SAME VISIT she was recorded praising the gym floor. Apr 25: final invoice $92,949.61.

DISPUTE
Apr 27: formal 10-day demand. May 4: her $12,061 deduction list (gym floor, garage ceiling, water heaters, patio leak) + billed-not-done claims; "rat's ass" text; threatened $3,000/mo storage deductions. May 8: attorney demand (Knutzen). May 13: emailed Knutzen directly — sympathy content, new invented claims ($72K storage, $32K AirBnB, electrical, kitchen leaks), bragged about the $2M home, admitted "in my opinion Mr. Green broke the contract," offered $65,900. ~May 19: accused GD of disturbing AC-closet insulation. Late May: silence.

HER CLAIMS AND WHY THEY FAIL
Gym floor $1,561 — recorded praising it; third party damaged it after install; her own text said $500; materials alone ~$1,500.
Garage ceiling/playroom $3,600 — not Claim 2 scope; she hired another contractor and admitted it in writing Apr 14.
Water heaters $3,200 — used 4 months without complaint (acceptance by use); no written notice or chance to cure. LEAST-WEAK — verify billing in the Claim 2 estimate.
Patio leak $1,750 — separate USAA claim she filed; potential double-dip; never our scope.
Laundry latch / glass knob — never billed; in neither estimate.
Kitchen tile — we hold the tile; work suspended for non-payment; she chose wood.
Storage / AirBnB $3–8K/mo — no contract basis; moved out by choice.

EVIDENCE
Audio of her praising the gym floor after written complaints (TX one-party consent). Matterport baseline (disproved stolen switch-plate/faucet accusation). Two witnesses to "waiting on a land sale". Rosie (Hidalgo's AC): her contractors caused AC-closet damage; Donna tried to hire Rosie behind GD's back. Full email/text trail. Disgruntled sub threatened to rip out work; cease-and-desist sent, payment proved, his own text calls it "a prank". Provably false statements in her emails (two-year timeline, "Bobby never reached out", caregiver claim — Eileen is the caregiver).

GOOD FAITH (all documented, no charge) — decontaminated her mail 4x, inspected 3 properties she considered buying, Christmas Day leak fix, 9 unpaid hours at her Elevation mediation, performed ahead of her payment schedule.

ELEVATION PRECEDENT — same playbook on Elevation Construction; they had video, held firm, she paid $10K that day. GD has more proof than Elevation had.

STRATEGY — demand sent; FILING WITH THE COURTS. No lien (deliberate). Interest and fees enforceable once suit is filed.

OPEN ITEMS — firm filing date from DJ; whether her land sale closed; Rosie's written statement finalized; water-heater billing verified in the Claim 2 estimate.
jobs.caseSummary: Green Dynasty vs. Donna Rains — 105 Glynn Way Dr. Balance unpaid: $92,949.61 (Claim 2 build-back $153,159.04, $60,000 paid, pantry credit $209.43). Your stake: 40% of recovery — $37,179.84 if collected in full. Strategy: demand letter sent (Apr 27 / May 8, atty Knutzen), FILING WITH THE COURTS — no lien, by choice. Her offer on the table was $65,900 (May 13). Contract: 1.5%/mo interest ($46.47/day), she pays attorney fees on breach, no mediation clause. Her deductions (~$12,061) all rebutted — recorded audio of her praising the gym floor, Matterport baseline, two witnesses to the 'waiting on a land sale' admission, Rosie confirms her contractors caused the AC-closet damage. Weakest point ours to check: water heater billing in the Claim 2 estimate. Precedent: she pulled the same play on Elevation and paid $10K the day they held firm. Bobby is handling; you are waiting on updates.
